method: Actual browser_api.run water_actions with empty input; exact integer action/character ledger, not manufactured UI traces.

result.title: Water displacements: from a matrix column to vibrational selection rules

conventions.columns: Column j is the image of the original displacement basis vector j.
conventions.scope: A fixed bent nonlinear molecule. Displacements and translations are polar; rotations are axial. Character subtraction identifies symmetry types, not force-constant eigenvectors.

drawing.scope: Illustrative equilibrium coordinates rounded to 12 decimal places for display only; all action matrices and characters are exact integers independent of the drawing angle.

vibrations.scope: Three symmetry types only. The two A1 coordinates may mix in a force field; no normal-mode eigenvectors, force constants, frequencies or intensities are supplied.

selectionChannels.scope: Symmetry permission from a totally symmetric vibrational ground state; no intensity or frequency is inferred.
